description: Shared Simple-With-Us Renovate limits (owner request, Nov 16 2026).  Each fleet repo extends this after config:recommended, so its own renovate.json still wins on any key it sets (minimumReleaseAge, groups, holds, automerge, labels).
Goal: one weekly batch of dependency PRs per repo instead of a stream, fewer CI runs, and lockfile updates that do not silently drop packages.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Major updates come once a month as their own PRs and never automerge, so a human reviews every major before it lands.  Repos keep their own major labels, holds and PR text.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Keep the npm <12 constraint above in place.  npm 12 defaults allow-remote to none, and `npm install --package-lock-only` (what Renovate runs for lockfiles) then refuses registry tarballs of packages with bundleDependencies, such as @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi, with EALLOWREMOTE (npm/cli#9800, still open on npm 12.2.1).  Drop the constraint and this rule once a fixed npm 12 ships.
